name: GMV Winlet 600
summary: Self-propelled, partly hydraulic glazing robot with front-wheel drive that lifts and fits windows and glass of up to 600 kg with linear fine lift and side shift. Made by GMV A/S in Denmark; being replaced by the Winlet 610TL and sold while stock lasts.

germany.statusNote: GMV A/S (Bredsten, Denmark) sells Winlet glazing robots direct, with German-language product pages and a quote form. The Winlet range starts at EUR 24,600 ("Wir bieten Winlet ab: EUR 24.600 an-"); which model this applies to and whether it is net is not stated. No German dealer is named. GMV says the Winlet 600 remains available while stock lasts.

sellers.name: GMV A/S
sellers.note: Office and production: Industriparken 1, DK-7182 Bredsten (sales: Sales@gmvas.dk). German quote form on the product page; the Winlet overview page says "Wir bieten Winlet ab: EUR 24.600 an-" without naming the model.

specs.label: Hydraulic functions
specs.quote: Wie Winlet 350 ist der Winlet 600 mit vier hydraulischen Funktionen sowie ein Vakuumdrehgelenk ausgestattet.

specs.label: Drive
specs.value: front-wheel drive, for halls and terrain
specs.quote: Durch den kräftigen Vorderradantrieb eignet sich der Winlet 600 Fensterroboter nicht nur für arbeiten in der Halle ideal, sondern auch im Gelände.

notes: Maker says the front-wheel drive suits both hall and terrain work (roughGround is a maker claim).
Fine lift up/down and side shift left/right with 100 % linear movement.

images.alt: Winlet 600 glazing robot lifting a large glass pane at a shop front
